description: This is a C source file containing unit tests implemented with the cmocka framework for a wireless LAN management module. It includes setup and teardown routines, multiple test cases focusing on FSM state transitions, dependency handling, and command commits related to radio and access point configurations.

methods.description: Initializes test environment, activates FSM manager, sets delay parameters for a mock object.

methods.name: int teardown_suite(void ** state _UNUSED)
methods.description: Dismantles the test environment, destroys the test manager and associated resources.

methods.name: void test_postInit(void ** state _UNUSED)
methods.description: Verifies initial FSM state, ensures radio FSM and VAP states are correctly initialized.

methods.name: void test_disableAp(void ** state _UNUSED)
methods.description: Tests disabling and enabling of an access point, checks FSM transition and counters.

methods.description: Mock callback that sets IW private commands on the access point's FSM action array.

methods.name: void s_pushEnable(T_Radio * pRad _UNUSED)
methods.description: Mock callback that pushes VAP enable command and triggers radio commit.

methods.name: void test_addFlagPreDependency(void ** state _UNUSED)
methods.description: Ensures that flags are correctly set before dependency copy steps, modifications are reflected in commits.

methods.name: void test_addFlagPostDependencyWithComPend(void ** state _UNUSED)
methods.description: Tests setting flags during dependency handling, including command commitments and callback execution.

methods.name: void s_pushAutoCommit(T_AccessPoint * pAP,T_Radio * pRad _UNUSED,wld_th_fsmStates_e state _UNUSED)
methods.description: Mock callback to automatically enable the AP for testing.

methods.name: void test_addAutoCommitPostDependency(void ** state _UNUSED)
methods.description: Verifies automatic commit behavior post dependency setup, ensuring correctness of FSM transitions.

methods.name: int main(int argc _UNUSED,char * argv[]_UNUSED)
methods.description: Entry point for the test suite, configures tracing, registers tests, and runs them in order.
